verdict.rationale: Shortwave docs say the AI assistant can 'search your entire email history,' and a community note confirms search exists but that the free plan excludes mail older than 90 days before signup. Nothing in the pack covers search operators, filters, ranking or speed. missing for 10: documented search operators/filters syntax, ranked-results behavior, evidence of search speed/precision, full-history coverage on all plans, independent hands-on corroboration
